facts.anchor: His mother had been dead for close to six weeks.

facts.fact: 他父亲死了将近六分钟。
facts.anchor: His father, closer to six minutes.

facts.fact: 他在楼梯底下跪在父亲尸体旁，等自己的心跳慢下来、停下来。
facts.anchor: He’d knelt over the body, at the bottom of the stairs

facts.fact: 他来教堂是为了赎罪，本以为那份轻松会散掉，换成恐惧、愧疚和悲伤。
facts.anchor: He’d come to the chapel to atone

facts.fact: 他身后的空气微微发亮，显出翅膀的轮廓：加百列，天使长，报信者。
facts.anchor: The outline of wings. Gabriel, the archangel. The messenger.

facts.fact: 伊莱问「为什么道歉」，天使就在那一句之后刺了他。
facts.anchor: right before the angel stabbed him

facts.fact: 幻象碎了，他坐在 EON 自己房间的床沿，一把小刀插在腰侧。
facts.anchor: a small knife jutting from his side

facts.fact: 他照加百列说的没拔刀，起身跟在后面，血一路点在地上。
facts.anchor: blood dotting the floor in his wake
